_comment: Verified-working reconstruction toolchain. The COLMAP version pin is load-bearing, not a preference -- see colmap_version_conflict below.

ffmpeg.note: On PATH via %LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\WinGet\Links. extract_frames.find_tool() also checks that directory directly, because a shell started before install will not have it on PATH.

colmap.note: 3.12.6 is the version GLOMAP 1.2.0 was built against. Use it for anything feeding GLOMAP.

colmap_version_conflict.problem: GLOMAP 1.2.0 cannot read a COLMAP 4.2.0 database.
colmap_version_conflict.symptom: SQLite error: SQL logic error / Failed to open database with registered factory
colmap_version_conflict.cause: COLMAP 4.x added rigs/frames/frame_data/rig_sensors tables and moved pose columns off the images table. GLOMAP 1.2.0 predates that schema.
colmap_version_conflict.resolution: Build the database with COLMAP 3.12.6 (the version GLOMAP 1.2.0 bundles). Verified working 2026-09-21.

cli_option_names._comment: Option names differ between the two COLMAP majors. Using the wrong one is a hard parse error, not a warning.

verified_pipeline.machine: i5-10310U, 15.8 GB RAM, Intel UHD, no CUDA
verified_pipeline.input: 30 raytraced frames, 480x360, orbiting camera, textured quads
verified_pipeline.caveat: This proves the toolchain reconstructs. It is a tiny synthetic scene -- 60 points is not a usable asset. Real footage with more texture and overlap is needed for anything exportable.

known_failure_modes.cause: Imagery has no high-frequency texture. Flat-shaded solids and gradient test patterns produce no keypoints.
known_failure_modes.fix: Use real footage, or synthetic imagery with per-surface noise texture.

known_failure_modes.symptom: No good initial image pair found / config=6 PLANAR_OR_PANORAMIC
known_failure_modes.cause: Matches exist but the two-view geometry is degenerate -- no valid essential matrix. Point-splat renders without true perspective surfaces do this.
known_failure_modes.fix: Imagery must have genuine parallax: real perspective projection of real surfaces.
